description: MeitY and UP to set up three AI Centres of Excellence at AKTU, HBTU and IIIT Lucknow under IndiaAI Mission, with Rs 50 crore each to boost AI R&D and startups.
body_lead: Lucknow: The Union ministry of electronics and information technology (MeitY), in partnership with the Uttar Pradesh govt, will set up three centres of excellence in artificial intelligence (AI-COEs) in the state under the IndiaAI Mission to promote AI innovation, research and startup incubation. The AI-COEs will be established at APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow; Harcourt Butler Technical University (HBTU), Kanpur; and the Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT), Lucknow, officials said.
